outputSamples.title: Under packets about OpenAI's AI governance initiatives or broader AI regulation debates.
outputSamples.angle: near-term prediction on regulatory default shift
outputSamples.text: OpenAI's governance framing will become the default language for AI regulation talks. Teams that don't align their public stance early will face higher customer and regulatory friction within a year.

outputSamples.title: Under packets about launches of new AI dev tools or model upgrades.
outputSamples.angle: decision rule for adoption based on workflow testing
outputSamples.text: Before migrating to a new AI platform, test one real workflow for speed, rollback, and default behavior. If only the demo improves, wait. Operational fit outweighs feature novelty.

outputSamples.title: Under packets about Google's AI integration in Android or Pixel, or platform distribution shifts.
outputSamples.angle: near-term prediction on Google's default AI and its market impact
outputSamples.text: Google's AI is shifting from a feature to a default on Pixel. This changes the distribution game: Android competitors will face a growing tax on consumer attention. Expect ripple effects across app ecosystems.

outputSamples.title: Under packets about Big Tech regulation, lawsuits, or AI product design.
outputSamples.angle: decision rule for building compliance-ready AI systems
outputSamples.text: Meta's lawsuit risk highlights a broader trend: platforms monetizing attention will face regulatory pressure on algorithms. Build AI products with opt-out mechanisms by default now, not after mandates arrive.
